answer: Implementing the willow consensus protocol requires AI agents to commit staked assets, establishing a distinct economic horizon for participation. This mechanism thwarts Sybil attacks by mandating that every cryptographic plume of activity be anchored to a unique, verifiable stake. Consequently, an attacker incurs a linear capital expenditure for each fraudulent identity, making the cost of subversion prohibitively high compared to any potential adversarial gain from network manipulation.
